registries.name: contract_catalog
registries.description: Canonical catalog for generated event/schema/id/operation registry views.

registries.name: error_codes
registries.description: Standard service-level and per-item error code registry.

registries.name: account_data_types
registries.description: Canonical Account Data key-pattern registry for actor/private account state.

registries.name: event_kinds
registries.description: Generated registry view for standard cx.* Event.kind values and wire scopes.

registries.name: id_kinds
registries.description: Generated registry view for cx:<kind>: typed ID prefixes and storage/wire rules.

registries.name: operations
registries.description: Generated registry view for service operation IDs across HTTP, gRPC, and message-queue surfaces.

registries.name: capability_actions
registries.description: Generated registry view for canonical capability action vocabulary, risk tiers, required constraints, and event_kind targets.

registries.name: registry_manifest
registries.description: Index of every machine-readable registry file under artifacts/registry.

registries.name: vectors
registries.description: Canonical machine index of cx.vector.* conformance vector identifiers and their defining prose/fixture sources.

registries.name: schemas
registries.description: Generated registry view for active schema IDs and schema file locations.

registries.name: morph_type_decision_table
registries.description: Canonical merge precedence + conflict rules for the four Morph type declaration sources (schema_refs, realm morph_type_profiles, morph_type, facets). Referenced normatively from zh/models/morph.md §4.

registries.name: removed_event_kinds
registries.description: Machine-readable list of Event.kind values removed from v1. Consumed by cotest drift scanner to flag downstream usage.

registries.name: deprecated_profile_ids
registries.description: Profile ids that are deprecated or were never canonical. Consumed by cotest drift scanner.

registries.name: removed_operation_ids
registries.description: Operation ids removed from the canonical operation registry. Consumed by cotest drift scanner.

registries.name: forbidden_wire_fields
registries.description: Field names that MUST NOT appear in specified wire contexts (envelope / payload). Consumed by cotest drift scanner.

registries.name: forbidden_model_terms
registries.description: Terms that MUST NOT be used in current-model prose, code identifiers, or UI copy. Consumed by cotest drift scanner.

registries.name: renames
registries.description: Canonical mapping from removed / deprecated identifiers to their v1 replacements (or null when no successor). Consumed by cotest and migration tooling.
